subject: Post-demo security intake & DR runbook request
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Romero <alex@pinetreehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo security intake & DR runbook request

Hi Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and the handful of items we discussed so we can keep the procurement path moving: 

- Priority asks from your security/cyber team: SOC 2 status, data residency/GDPR posture, HIPAA attestation for PHI flows.
- Request: a current SOC 2 report (Type II preferred) or an expected availability date. If still in progress, a short timeline is fine.
- Operational ask: copy of your Incident Response (IR) policy or a runbook summary (BCP/DR) that outlines breach notification timelines and escalation points.
- Vendor side: we can send our standard vendor security questionnaire and a short secure-upload link for evidence (SOC, penetration test summary, runbooks).

Next steps I propose: 
1) You share SOC 2 status + any IR/DR runbook excerpts by EOD Mon 9/20.
2) We’ll send the vendor question set and a secure upload location.
3) If helpful, schedule a 30-min follow-up with your security lead and our security engineer to walk the runbook and timelines.

Attachments: redwood-security-one-pager.pdf (company summary)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference (www.redwood.ai)
From: Alex Romero <alex@pinetreehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@pinetreehealth.com, CISO, PineTree Health <ciso@pinetreehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 16:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo security intake & DR runbook request

Jordan — thanks for the clear list and for the demo. Quick answers: 

- SOC 2: In progress (Type II). Testing window closed last week; expected report delivery from our auditor by 10/15/2026. I attached a draft letter summarizing scope and coverage (pinetree-soc2-letter-draft.pdf).
- HIPAA: We operate under a Business Associate Agreement with our clinical partners. We do not currently accept PHI into third-party hosted LLMs; any PHI flows are routed to our on-prem enclave. We can provide our HIPAA policy excerpt.
- GDPR/Data residency: Primary data sits in us-central; we have DPA signed with select vendors.
- IR / BCP: We can share a sanitized runbook summary. For regulatory timelines, we follow: initial containment/notification internally within 24 hours, customer notification windows vary (we aim for 72 hours where applicable), and formal regulator notifications per jurisdiction timelines.

I’ve uploaded the draft SOC letter and a starter vendor questionnaire to the secure folder (link below). I’ll also bring in our security lead on the follow-up call — available next week Tue/Wed afternoons.

Secure folder: https://secure-upload.pinetreehealth.com/r/redwood-intake
Attachments: pinetree-soc2-letter-draft.pdf, pinetree-vendor-questionnaire.xlsx

Best,
Alex Romero
Director of Platform Ops | PineTree Health
alex@pinetreehealth.com | +1 617-555-3478

Jordan / Monica — quick internal note after Alex’s reply: 

- Alex gave a realistic SOC 2 arrival date (10/15). We should prepare a short bridging pack (what to accept in lieu of full report: SOC scope letter, latest pen test summary).
- Action: Monica, can you draft the vendor evidence request email and the secure-upload instructions for PineTree? Include a checklist: SOC letter, pen test exec summary, IR/BCP runbook excerpt, encryption config, and retention policy.
- Action: Jordan, propose two slots for a 30-min follow-up in Tue/Wed window and loop in our security engineer (I recommend > security@redwood.ai > but use Rachel Kim for continuity).

Also, note the breach notification phrasing Alex used — they said 72 hours where applicable. We should explicitly ask for the formal notification SLA and the named escalation contacts (phone + email) in the runbook excerpt.

Marissa

Alex — appreciate the fast turnaround and the uploads. Two quick items before we loop security for the call: 

1) Could you confirm the formal breach-notification SLA language used in your runbook (we need the exact timing and whether it’s business days vs calendar days for regulator/customer notifications)?
2) Please provide the named escalation contacts (title, email, phone) for IR and BCP on your side. That will help our on-call routing during POC and later prod.

We’ll send the vendor questionnaire back with a DocuSign link for the non-disclosure clause and a secure upload path for any sensitive evidence. Proposed follow-up windows (pick one):
- Tue 9/21, 2:00–2:30pm PT
- Wed 9/22, 3:30–4:00pm PT

If both are OK, we’ll book the earlier slot and include Rachel (security engineer) and Marissa. I’ve attached our intake checklist for reference.

Attachments: redwood-security-one-pager.pdf, redwood-evidence-checklist.docx

Thanks — Jordan
